title: 入学・入園のイラスト
subject_en: School and kindergarten entrance (April) objects and children, each a separate object; children are about 3-head proportion with round faces and simple uniforms, kawaii soft style with sakura pink, cream and spring colours. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (shirts, paper, flowers) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters on signs, badges or paper.
lead: ランドセル・さくらの校門・園児の帽子など、入学・入園の春の素材12点です。お知らせや4月のおたより、お祝いカードに使えます。
items: a red school backpack (randoseru) with a small flap, standing
a small boy with a black school backpack, waving happily
a small girl with a red school backpack, smiling
a school gate with two pillars and a cherry tree in bloom beside it (blank nameplate)
a yellow kindergarten hat with a chin strap
a small child in a smock and yellow hat holding a tiny bag, cheerful
a pair of cream indoor school shoes with a blue toe
a blank name badge with a tulip shape and a safety pin
three tulips in red, yellow and pink with leaves
a rosette-style ribbon flower in red and cream with two streamers (no letters)
an open lunch box with rice, a tiny octopus sausage and broccoli
